items.name: The operator starts a run, and it performs the cycle's effects up to the score
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: A green HTTP candidate passed the cycle; progress recorded the eleven specified effects in order, including gate-attempt-passed.

items.name: A run identity is started once
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: After R-1 failed at fence, a second start with R-1 refused run-already-started; the runs query listed it once under C-1.

items.name: A second run is refused while the first is running
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: With the builder sleeping, progress showed R-1 running; a second start refused run-in-progress and R-2 progress returned null.

items.name: A cycle is run once
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: After R-1 passed, a start of R-2 for C-1 refused cycle-already-run and R-2 progress was null.

items.name: A run of something that is not a commit of the project repository is refused
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: Started with a nonexistent 40-digit commit; start-run refused not-a-commit and run-progress returned null; builder was not launched.

items.name: A checklist Measurement refuses halts the run with Measurement's refusal
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: An empty fixture spec produced a refused checklist with empty-checklist and halted before self-check and fence.

items.name: A plan whose item identities a fresh stamp does not give back halts the run before the cycle
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: Adding an untagged scenario produced a recorded stamp and a stamp halt for mismatched identities, before pin and checklist.

items.name: A failing self-check fails the cycle at the fence, and the run with it
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: A failing self-check produced the expected fence failure, but a subsequent refused fail-cycle effect was recorded, so self-check was not the last effect.

items.name: A check the self-check skips is recorded as a listed skip
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: A self-check printing SKIP bb-tools recorded a passed self-check with that line in its detail.

items.name: A fenced path that matches nothing fails the cycle at the fence
items.rule: The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
items.evidence: A nonexistent fenced path led to fenced-path-matched-nothing, a recorded fail-cycle, and a fence-refused failure before the builder.

items.name: The fresh builder sees the clean room of one commit with no fenced path
items.rule: The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
items.evidence: The builder recorded plan and config, an empty impl directory and one commit; git rev-list --objects showed neither fenced impl nor harness/cycles.

items.name: Each regenerate runs one builder session and waits for it
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: A red then green HTTP builder launched exactly twice with distinct session IDs; the first regeneration and gate finished before the repair launch and second gate.

items.name: A builder that exits non-zero but leaves a candidate is gated
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: A builder left its candidate and exited 1; the candidate was recorded with a digest, passed the command gate and the cycle passed.

items.name: A builder that leaves nothing fails the cycle at regenerate
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: An empty builder led to a recorded fail-cycle and regenerate failure candidate-not-regenerated, with no regenerate effect.

items.name: A builder that outlives the regenerate timeout is stopped and the cycle fails for its budget
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: A builder sleeping 30 seconds with a two-second regenerate budget was stopped, and the cycle failed at regenerate for budget.

items.name: Something answering on the port is a gate refusal, and three in a row fail the cycle
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: With an HTTP server already answering the port, three gate attempts refused seam-answered-before-boot, each followed by gate-refusal; the cycle failed for infrastructure and the candidate launch marker was absent.

items.name: A red suite fails the attempt before the candidate is booted
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: A red suite with a launch marker produced suite-red and gate-attempts-exhausted; the marker was absent, showing start.sh did not run.

items.name: A candidate with no launch entrypoint fails the attempt for a missing contract
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: A candidate with executable test.sh and no start.sh produced gate-attempt-failed for contract-missing.

items.name: A served page without the marker fails the attempt for its identity
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: A candidate serving fixture under the configured sauna marker failed the gate for identity-probe-failed.

items.name: What a builder writes after it ended does not reach the gate
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: A detached builder process changed its original suite to red after exit; the gate copy passed, and install and regenerate recorded the same digest.

items.name: A repair builder sees the previous candidate and the gate evidence, read-only
items.rule: A failed gate attempt is repaired by a fresh builder that sees only the previous candidate and the gate's evidence
items.evidence: A red first suite led to a verification-repair event naming attempt 1 evidence; the repair room contained the clean tree, previous candidate and gate evidence, and writes to both latter mounts failed.

items.name: Three failed attempts fail the cycle, no fourth builder is launched, and nothing is graded
items.rule: A failed gate attempt is repaired by a fresh builder that sees only the previous candidate and the gate's evidence
items.evidence: Three red candidates produced three builder launches and gate-attempts-exhausted; no item researcher request or file-verdicts effect followed.

items.name: An item the judge did not score is Measurement's to record as unreached
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: Researcher code branched on item identity and threw for 01-002; only 01-001 was filed, the measurement marked 01-002 unreached, and the run passed with 1 of 2.

items.name: A run that ended stays as it ended
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: A fence self-check failure and an empty-selection checklist halt retained their failed and halted statuses and identical effect results five seconds after responding.

items.name: Reading a run's progress changes nothing
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: After a passing run, two consecutive run-progress responses were identical and showed passed.

items.name: The identity probe is handed the served URL, and passes a candidate that serves the marker
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: An HTTP probe accepting only the full configured URL and its marker passed attempt 1, and the run passed.

items.name: A candidate whose suite writes inside its own directory passes the gate
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: A suite created and removed impl/tmp during its run; the HTTP gate passed and install and regenerate carried the same digest.

items.name: A skipped check is recorded with the whole text after SKIP
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: The self-check printed the full legacy SKIP line; the passed event lists the entire text after SKIP as the skipped check.

items.name: A stdio candidate whose suite, identity probe and store check pass passes the gate
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: A stdio candidate with passing suite, probe and store check passed the run; its gate event records 30 seconds, one poll, answered on one, and the probe text.

items.name: The identity probe is handed the gate room's launch entrypoint, the boot budget and the gate's store, and the store check reads that store
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: The stdio probe recorded the absolute gate start.sh and 30, with only the attempt GATE_STORE and no LOYLY variables; the store check received that same path.

items.name: A red stdio suite fails the attempt before the identity probe, and the suite is handed no store
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: A red stdio suite recorded no GATE_STORE or LOYLY variables, failed as suite-red, and neither probe nor store check recorded a launch.

items.name: An identity probe that fails fails the attempt for its identity, and the store is not checked
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: The stdio probe printed the timeout line and failed; the gate recorded identity-probe-failed with that line, and the store check did not run.

items.name: A store check that fails fails the attempt for its identity, with the store check's output as the detail
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: A passing stdio probe followed by the failing store check recorded identity-probe-failed with the store check text, and the cycle failed for gate-attempts-exhausted.

items.name: A stdio candidate reads the spec beside it in the gate room
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: A stdio suite requiring the plan at its root-relative path passed the gate; install and regenerate carried the same candidate digest.

items.name: A stdio run whose store check cannot be started halts at the gate
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: A stdio run without a store-check command halted at gate for effect-could-not-run and recorded no gate result.

items.name: The harness digest of a stdio run covers the store-check command
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: Two stdio runs on the same store used store-check command texts ending in one and two; both first self-checks passed and their harness digests differed.

items.name: A slice that is a symbolic link in the plan is read at its target
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: A plan link 01-a to ../spec/a stamped both items and derived both checklist entries with sources under plan/01-a; it did not halt.

items.name: The configuration's plan slices select what is stamped and checklisted
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: A two-slice plan selected 02; only 02-001 was stamped and the derived checklist contains only that item.

items.name: Each builder is handed the configured builder image, and each regenerate names the image and its digest
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: Both builder launches received the configured image path as their third argument; regenerate and repair details named builder-clojure and its digest.

items.name: A start whose configured builder image is not in the builder images directory is refused
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: A configuration naming a missing builder-clojure image caused start-run to refuse builder-image-missing; no run was created.

items.name: Two runs on one store compare the second cycle with the first
items.rule: Measurement keeps its history across runs on the one store, so a scoreboard compares a cycle with the last measured cycle of its selection
items.evidence: Two runs on one store both passed; the second stamp recorded no new identities, and the C-2 scoreboard named C-1 as previous cycle.

items.name: An identity probe that reads a file beside it in the cut passes a candidate that serves the marker
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: An HTTP probe reading its marker beside itself passed the gate, and install and regenerate recorded the same digest.

items.name: A gate command that exits 0 passes the attempt with the budget, the poll and the probe line it printed
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: The command ran once in the project repo with the cut tree, candidate copy and empty evidence directory; its computed candidate digest matched install. Gate recorded 20 polls, 10 seconds, poll 3 and probe text, and start.sh was not launched.

items.name: A gate command that exits 1 naming a reason fails the attempt with that reason, and the repair builder is handed its evidence
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: A command gate first returned suite-red and then passed after repair; the failed event detail included BOOT and the reason prefix instead of the specified detail alone.

items.name: A gate command whose last line is a refusal to grade is a gate refusal, and three in a row fail the cycle
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: A gate command returning seam-answered-before-boot produced three refused gates, each followed by gate-refusal, and the cycle failed at gate for infrastructure.

items.name: A gate command whose last line names no code the runner reads halts the run at the gate
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: The unrecognized infrastructure line halted at gate with no gate or fail-cycle effect, but its halt detail included the preceding BOOT line rather than the specified last line alone.

items.name: The harness digest covers the gate command, and is unchanged when none is handed in
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: Three passing runs with no gate command, gate-a and gate-b had three distinct self-check digests; the no-command digest matched SHA-256 of config bytes, self-check command text and probe bytes in order.

items.name: Each effect a run records lies inside the leaf of the tree named for that effect
items.rule: The run is one ORC tree, cycle.v1, and each effect the runner performs is a leaf of its own
items.evidence: A passing HTTP run recorded the eleven specified effects; the reference Grain store check found each modeled effect event inside its named leaf of the cycle or delegated child tick.

items.name: A candidate that refuses its first three requests is answered on a later poll, its margin 20 less that poll
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: An HTTP candidate returned 503 for its first three requests; the gate passed on poll 5 of 20 with a 10-second budget and attempt margin 15.

items.name: Each gate attempt runs as a child tick of its own of the workflow "cycle-runner/gate-attempt.v1"
items.rule: A gate attempt is one subtree, delegated once per attempt
items.evidence: A red then green HTTP suite passed on attempt 2; the store shows two gate-attempt.v1 child ticks, with each attempt’s effects in its tick and repair in the first. The reference leaf check passed.

items.name: A copy of the candidate in a folder of its own, with no spec around it, runs a cycle
items.rule: The runner carries its own event model, as its room gave it
items.evidence: A candidate copied to a temporary directory under /tmp, with no .pi ancestor, passed an HTTP cycle and recorded gate-attempt-passed; the temporary copy was removed.

items.name: The judge scores each item in a child tick of its own, the scores are filed as scored, and the run passes as its cycle passes
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The judge scored booked pass and no receipt fail; measurement filed 1 of 2 and the cycle passed. Grain shows two distinct grade.v1 child ticks of the run, each holding its item-named score.

items.name: Each item's grading starts with no other item's evidence
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The researcher returned E-ONE for 01-001 and E-TWO for 01-002; the first judge received E-ONE and neither 01-002 request contained it.

items.name: The researcher is given the item, the seam and the event model, and a shell in the grading room only
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The researcher prompt included the fixture scenario, seam, and event model. Its shell returned Linux and listed the clean grading room with impl and plan; ls .. showed only that item room.

items.name: A judge reply with the level of a pass and no reasoning scores nothing, and the item is filed unreached
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The judge replied without reasoning for 01-002; progress and the Grain store showed only the 01-001 score, and measurement filed 01-002 unreached with 1 of 2 passing.

items.name: A sealed grader whose digest the run did not approve halts the run before the cycle
items.rule: A run grades only with the approved sealed grader
items.evidence: An unapproved rubric digest halted at grader with the actual digest in its detail, before self-check, fence or builder.

items.name: No item scored fails the score stage, and the run fails with its cycle
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: After a passing command gate, every researcher received an invalid model reply; file-verdicts refused zero-verdicts, fail-score-stage was recorded, and the cycle failed at score without another builder.

items.name: A runner stopped while a builder session runs resumes the run, and the session with it
items.rule: A run stopped with its runner resumes where it stopped
items.evidence: After stopping the runner five seconds into the first builder, restart launched the same session ID again, but after 120 progress polls the run remained running; regenerate was refused cycle-concluded and subsequent install and gate were refused.

items.name: The builder's instruction is the rendered text, and the repair's adds only the closing paragraph
items.rule: The builder instruction is rendered by the model, and the builder is handed nothing more
items.evidence: The first builder received exactly INSTRUCTION-7; the second received it followed by one paragraph naming previous-candidate and gate-evidence paths.

items.name: A render the model does not reply to halts the run before any builder
items.rule: The builder instruction is rendered by the model, and the builder is handed nothing more
items.evidence: With the render endpoint unavailable, the run halted at render for effect-could-not-run, with no regenerate, builder, fail-cycle, or concluded cycle.

items.name: Reading a running run shows its tick and the leaves it completed
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: During a sleeping builder, progress showed a running tick, completed fence and render nodes, and regenerate as the last running node.
